title: Autumn/Moon seam review queue
purpose: Collapse the seven v0.45 autumn/moon candidates blocked by unclassified seams into three source-review tasks, without guessing morphology.

required_questions: D=むす is what morphological segment in the source reading?
reverse D=すむ is what segment/function in ku4?
Does the D boundary remain compatible when the outer A factor changes?
queue.forbidden_inference: Do not infer 娘/住む solely because the kana can be segmented that way; confirm from source text or independent textual evidence.

required_questions: Where is the actual morpheme boundary inside こたしろし?
What is the parse/function of reverse D=たこ in たこともちみる?
Is this seam source-specific or transferable?
queue.forbidden_inference: Do not assign こた/たこ a lexical analysis from sound resemblance or palindrome structure.

known_reverse_side_signature.note: v0.36 already treats また as morphologically ambiguous.

required_questions: What is B=たま in the source phrase たまはのきはの?
What is reverse B=また at the beginning of ku5-side mirror span?
Does the known ambiguity of B=また make this pair source-specific?
queue.forbidden_inference: Do not treat たま as safe merely because it reverses to an already attested また; that side is explicitly blocked in v0.36.

review_order.rationale: むす and こた each block three candidates; たま blocks one and is additionally shadowed by the known blocked また signature.

expected_effect.if_D_musu_is_transferable: up to 3 candidates become eligible for semantic review, not automatically accepted.
expected_effect.if_D_kota_is_transferable: up to 3 candidates become eligible for semantic review, not automatically accepted.
expected_effect.if_B_tama_is_transferable: hybrid-019 becomes eligible for semantic review, but the existing また ambiguity must be reconciled.
expected_effect.if_any_is_nontransferable: affected candidates remain held; no candidate is deleted.
